notes:
• Card sorting: 🟦 Square invoice on an order — makes a Square invoice for the balance (or any amount) with a due date, emailed to the customer when there's an email
• Square's API can't switch on partial payments, so the invoice is made as a draft and Square opens: Invoices → Drafts → open it → turn on Partial payments → Send
• Every payment the customer makes on the invoice is added to the order's payments by itself (↻ Check payments to update now); remove invoice deletes the draft or cancels it in Square
